name: Claude Mythos 5.2
description: Claude Mythos 5.2 is Anthropic's verification-only deployment of the same underlying model as Claude Fable 5.2, with more permissive safeguards in biology and cybersecurity, the high-risk dual-use domains where Fable carries additional safeguards. Access is limited to organizations verified through Anthropic's Cyber Verification Program or Life Sciences Verification Program; Claude Enterprise customers can also reach it indirectly through Claude Security. It shares Fable 5.2's specifications: text and image input, text output, tool use, adaptive thinking that is always on (default effort high), a 1M-token context window, 128K max output, and June 2026 knowledge and training-data cutoffs. Pricing matches Fable 5.2 at $8/$40 per million input/output tokens, with cache reads at $0.20, 5-minute cache writes at $10 and 1-hour cache writes at $16; fast mode ($16/$80) is limited to verification-program members and is not offered on Amazon Bedrock. Anthropic calls it its most capable model for cybersecurity engineering, rediscovering 89.6% of 1,829 October 2026 CVEs versus 78.3% for Mythos 5.1. Self-reported scores (safeguards off) include Terminal-Bench 4.0 70.5%, Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 75.3% and de novo protein binder design 85.1%. Available as `claude-mythos-5-2` on the Claude API, Claude Models on Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry, and as `anthropic.claude-mythos-5-2` on Amazon Bedrock, where the Cyber Verification Program is currently open only to organizations with a data retention exemption for Fable 5.2 or Fable 5.1.

benchmarks.name: Biomedical image analysis
benchmarks.description: Biomedical image analysis: quantitative analyses of biomedical images using domain tools.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Claude Mythos 5.2 evaluated without cyber and bio safeguards. System Card §8.18.5. Scaled to best competition results; one attempt per problem; max effort.

benchmarks.name: De novo protein binder design
benchmarks.description: De novo protein binder design: for each of 15 protein targets, design a set of 30 miniprotein binders within a fixed 24-hour wall-clock budget given the target structure.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Claude Mythos 5.2 evaluated without cyber and bio safeguards. Announcement + System Card Table 8.1.A / §8.18.4. 15 targets, 30 miniprotein binders each, 24h wall-clock budget, one H200; max effort.

benchmarks.name: LatchBio SingleCellBench
benchmarks.description: LatchBio SingleCellBench tests analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing data across problems spanning standard workflows such as labeling cell types, finding differentially expressed genes, and correcting batch effects.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Claude Mythos 5.2 evaluated without cyber and bio safeguards. System Card §8.18.1. Bash, file editor and prespecified packages; max effort; averaged over five attempts.

benchmarks.name: Medicinal Chemistry (ADME)
benchmarks.description: Medicinal chemistry ADME evaluation: 504 questions asking which real drug-discovery compounds have the highest or lowest measured absorption, distribution, or metabolism-related property.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Claude Mythos 5.2 evaluated without cyber and bio safeguards. System Card §8.18.3. 504 ADME questions; max effort.

benchmarks.name: Morphology-to-molecule matching
benchmarks.description: Axiom Bio morphology-to-molecule matching: match multi-channel cell imaging data from a human liver in-vitro assay to shuffled molecule-dose perturbations.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Claude Mythos 5.2 evaluated without cyber and bio safeguards. System Card §8.18.2. Axiom Bio liver assay matching; max effort.

benchmarks.name: Protein Design — Sequence Generation
benchmarks.description: Protein design Sequence Generation task: generate novel protein sequences conditioned on design constraints.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Claude Mythos 5.2 evaluated without cyber and bio safeguards. System Card §8.18.4. One attempt per problem; max effort.

benchmarks.name: Protocols Troubleshooting
benchmarks.description: Molecular biology Protocols Troubleshooting variant: detect and fix issues in laboratory protocols.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Claude Mythos 5.2 evaluated without cyber and bio safeguards. System Card §8.18.6. Max effort.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 4.0
benchmarks.description: Terminal-Bench 4.0 evaluates AI agents on real-world work in terminal and command-line containerized environments across 66 tasks, with emphasis on science-adjacent and frontier engineering problems. Relative to earlier Terminal-Bench releases, 4.0 increases timeouts and adaptively raises RAM/CPU on selected tasks to reduce harness and resource confounds.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Claude Mythos 5.2 evaluated without cyber and bio safeguards. System Card §8.5. Claude Code --bare at max effort, no internet access; 660 trials, SE ±1.8 pts. Fable 5.2 with safeguards scored 67.6%.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1
benchmarks.description: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 is a Stanford-led community benchmark of 70 tasks drawn from scientific research workflows across the life, physical, earth, mathematical, and engineering sciences. Tasks are authored and reviewed by scientists and researchers; scores are typically reported as accuracy with relatively large standard error due to strongly bimodal per-task outcomes.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Claude Mythos 5.2 evaluated without cyber and bio safeguards. Announcement + System Card §8.6. Claude Code --bare at max effort; 10 trials per task, SE ±4.3 pts. Fable 5.2 with safeguards scored 74.6%.
